title: Recent update is not working.
text: After the most recent update I need to verify being 18+ to access certain apps & websites. I have no credit card or passport & when I upload my proof of age card it never registers so now I can’t access what I got this useless IPad for. Changing to Samsung ASAP, at least they don’t support pedophile presidents like Apple’s CEO.
